title: VexLife Prod · Screen Lens
summary: The VexLife workspace exported by VexLife-Prod from its own Blueprint, VexWeb coordinates and owner constants.

notes: Exported by vexlife.lens.VexLifeProdScreenLens; VexWork pins the commit.
Element labels are Blueprint ids made readable. Visible copy is dynamic and owned by each Family's DisplayState.

screens.label: VexLife workspace
screens.summary: Browser and Companion side by side: converse with Vex, show Vex a window, and see what Vex receives.

annotations.detail: Shows VexLifeMemoryFamily's DisplayState from GET /api/v1/memory. Memory Controls are not connected to ordinary Product UI/runtime yet.
